what: offboarding erases an item from the log but never deletes its record from the store
note: an observable difference the invariant does not state: the closing sweep (engram/offboard/swept) deletes the records the erasure skipped, so the store and the reads end as without the mutant, but the log gains a swept event per record and the deletion report's deleted list is short; the two-handle walk cannot pin it (its crash-free walks sweep records for other reasons), and the offboarding acceptance test (packages/core/test/unit/plane/offboard.test.ts, no swept event after a plain offboarding) kills it
